messages.subject: inla.mesh.projector taking too long
parts:
Hello,
I have being running the code below and its been more than 48 hours and inla.mesh.projector is still running. 

stepsize <- 3 * 1 / 111 #3km pixels
x.range <- diff(range(brd2[,1]))
y.range <- diff(range(brd2[,2]))
nxy <- round(c(x.range, y.range)/stepsize)
nxy    #number of pixel in each direction 16691 x 13040
projgrid4 <- inla.mesh.projector(mesh4, xlim=range(brd2[,1]),
                                 ylim=range(brd2[,2]), dims=nxy)

when I modify the code as below and it runs fine with a the duration of ~10minutes

## this works in 10 minutes
stepsize <- 5 * 1 / 111 #5km pixels
x.range <- diff(range(brd2[,1]))
y.range <- diff(range(brd2[,2]))
nxy <- round(c(x.range, y.range)/stepsize)
nxy    #number of pixel in each direction 10015 * 7824
projgrid4 <- inla.mesh.projector(mesh4, xlim=range(brd2[,1]),
                                 ylim=range(brd2[,2]), dims=nxy)


Although, I recognize the pixel dimensions are different I feel the time duration for the 3km is too long. Any explanation for this long duration?

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla.mesh.projector taking too long
parts:
Probably a memory issue; 16691*13040 \approx 218 million points!
If you really need that many, consider breaking the calculation into
batches of subgrids.

Finn
